Hourly Charters

Perfect for city tours in Riyadh or Jeddah. Your driver stays with you, waiting at every stop. Ideal for shopping trips, restaurant hopping, or visiting multiple museums in a single afternoon.

  • Minimum 4 hours
  • Mileage limits apply per hour

Multi-Day Packages

Essential for trips to AlUla, NEOM, or the Asir region. The driver and vehicle are exclusively yours for consecutive days, giving you total freedom to explore remote areas.

  • 10 to 12 hours of service per day
  • Driver accommodation handled by us

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you offer hourly and full-day car hire?

Yes. You can hire a car with a driver by the hour or for a full day, with your driver waiting at every stop.

Which destinations are popular for day trips?

AlUla, NEOM and Tabuk, Abha in Asir, Taif, and Diriyah are among the most requested day-trip destinations.

Can the driver wait while I explore?

Yes. With charter bookings your driver stays with you throughout, so you never wait for a ride between stops.
